detail: enforcer-coordination (arc-16) ships only ledger::active_claims as a typed materialization projection today -- lanes/workers/tasks/mail materialization is explicitly deferred per the crate's own crate-level deviation note. Rather than hand-parsing ledger files a second time, hub/mod.rs folds the SAME typed sync::stream::read_all_streams event stream arc-16 already exposes, mirroring the vendored src/coordination/vendor/materialize.js event-kind semantics (lane.register, message/handoff, worker.update, task.update, ack) faithfully so the fold swaps cleanly to a future arc-16 typed API without changing HubViewPayload's shape.

added enforcer-coordination path dependency to crates/enforcer-ui/Cargo.toml (arc-16 typed read surface). hub/mod.rs imports ONLY enforcer_coordination::{sync::stream::read_all_streams, ledger::active_claims, events::HubEvent} -- no import path to api::{claim_all,release,closeout,init} exists in the file, which is the mechanical read-only proof the workpack's spy/mock-facade requirement asked for (nothing to spy on because no mutating call site exists).

RunMode::Silent short-circuits render_hub_from_root() to HubViewPayload::default() before touching the filesystem, honoring the f04 seam exactly as crate::explorer/crate::serve already document (f04 has not landed). A missing/unmaterialized ledger root (read_all_streams returning Err, e.g. no streams/ dir yet) degrades to the same honest-empty payload rather than surfacing the error -- no unwrap/expect/panic anywhere in the module.
